topic: Office space and room assignment details
summary_markdown: Discussion regarding office logistics. One participant confirmed they did not take the equipment/hardware. The other participant noted a shortage of HDMI cables but offered to bring them. They also discussed changing room assignments, noting that while a second space was canceled, only one shared space remains. However, the new contract specifies Room #9, suggesting eviction from the smaller room is unlikely.
decisions: The new agreement specifies occupancy in Room #9.
